description: This file handles server-side rendering in a Remix application, managing HTTP requests, response headers, and streaming HTML responses based on whether the requester is a bot or a browser.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function that handles incoming server requests, sets headers, distinguishes between bot and browser requests, and delegates to specific handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot user agents, streams HTML content, and manages rendering errors.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser user agents, streams HTML content, and manages rendering errors.
